summary: Completed testing of 12 operational adjustments from roleplay session 23/03/2026. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Driver column in Dashboard, Kosmo sync 10-min text, Visitas header, Devoluciones label, Revisado column with review buttons. Code review confirmed all P0/P1/P2 features implemented correctly.

P0-1_CSV_auto_filter.details: POST /api/upload/history-orders correctly filters empty order_reference_id rows and returns ignored_rows count. Tested with CSV containing 5 rows (2 empty), returned ignored_rows=2, total_orders=3

P0-2_Driver_column_Dashboard.details: Dashboard journeys table shows 'Driver' column between Proveedor and Paquetes. Verified in UI with driver names like 'Raymundo Enríquez', 'Jaime J.', 'Brian D.'

P0-3_Auto_calculated_close_metrics.details: Close form shows auto-calculated read-only values for Entregados/Fallidos/Devoluciones with 'calculado automáticamente' text. Code verified in JourneyDetail.jsx lines 1501-1524

P0-4_Pre_populated_failed_packages.details: When opening close form, packages with status 'failed' or kosmo_status_raw 'cancelled'/'failed' are pre-selected. Code verified in JourneyDetail.jsx lines 439-449

P1-5_Visitas_header.details: Journey detail header shows 'VISITAS' with count of delivered+failed+returned packages. Verified in UI showing '52 intentos registrados'

P1-6_Devoluciones_label.details: Close route summary shows 'Devoluciones' instead of 'Para reintento'. Verified in UI and code (JourneyDetail.jsx lines 1518, 1818)

P1-7_WhatsApp_driver_name.details: WhatsApp start summary includes 'Driver: {driverName}'. Code verified in utils.js line 112

P1-8_Resolve_all_incidents_API.details: PUT /api/incidents/journey/{journey_id}/resolve-all endpoint exists and returns resolved_count. Backend test passed

P1-8_UI_Resolver_todas_button.details: 'Resolver todas' button exists in Incidents tab (only visible when open incidents exist). Code verified in JourneyDetail.jsx lines 1345-1358

P1-9_Returned_status_API.details: PUT /api/journeys/{journey_id}/close sets failed_packages status to 'returned'. Code verified in server.py lines 717-722

P1-9_UI_Devuelto_badge.details: Packages with status 'returned' display 'Devuelto' badge with dark gray styling (bg-slate-600). Code verified in JourneyDetail.jsx line 871 and utils.js line 70

P2-10_10min_polling_interval.details: Kosmo sync scheduler runs every 10 minutes. Code verified: asyncio.sleep(10 * 60) in kosmo_sync.py line 243. Dashboard shows 'Sincronización Kosmo (cada 10 min)'

P2-11_Package_review_API.details: PUT /api/packages/{package_id}/review saves reviewed_by and reviewed_at. Backend test passed

P2-11_UI_Revisado_column.details: Packages table has 'Revisado' column with circle icon (unreviewed) or checkmark (reviewed). Verified in UI

P2-12_MAX_PACKAGES_250.details: kosmo_sync.py MAX_PACKAGES_PER_SYNC = 250. Code verified on line 38

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing journeys from previous sessions.
